note: The baseline job rebuilds the extract and refuses to measure anything unless every file matches the artifact that passed qualification. The rebuild is deterministic and the recorded build timestamp is passed in via --built-at, because meta.json embeds built_at_utc and would otherwise differ on every rebuild. Verified for this artifact: a rebuild on a different machine (4 vCPU / 1.9 GiB, the orchestration host) reproduced all five files byte-for-byte, digests and sizes identical to the gated copies.
